tools.name: talk_to_the_studio
tools.description: Talk to The Leos' own agent in plain language, the way a client would: describe the project, ask anything (the work, starting prices, the studio for rent and its kit, the team), and name a call time in words, with the client's email, to book it (a calendar invite with a video link goes to that email

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: What The Leos (film, photography and design studio, Milan and New York) makes, who for, and its rentable daylight studio in Milan.

tools.name: list_work
tools.description: The studio's published projects, optionally filtered by kind (brands, events, businesses) or a word (e.g. 'eyewear', 'jewellery', 'fashion week').

tools.name: estimate_budget
tools.description: Starting prices from the rate card (EUR, plus IVA, photo and video included). Final quotes are confirmed by a person.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Every open 30-minute call start with the studio for the next three weeks (weekdays, 10:00 to 18:00 Milan time), as Milan wall-clock times (slots), with UTC instants (times) and grouped by day (days). Coarse: start times only.

tools.name: submit_brief
tools.description: Send a project brief to the studio on behalf of a client. A person reads it and replies within one working day. Include a way to reach the client.

tools.name: request_call
tools.description: Book a 30-minute call with the studio at one of the slots from check_availability. The client's email is required: a calendar invite with a video link (Microsoft Teams) goes there, and the join link comes back here. The time is checked once more before booking.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: talk_to_the_studio · Public sink: talk_to_the_studio, submit_brief, request_call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: talk_to_the_studio · Public sink: talk_to_the_studio, submit_brief, request_call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "talk_to_the_studio" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Talk to The Leos' own agent in plain language, the way a client would: describe the project, ask anything (the work, starting prices, the studio for rent and its kit, the team), and name a call time in words to hold it. It answers in the studio's voice, one short line, and returns the brief so far, " → after: "Talk to The Leos' own agent in plain language, the way a client would: describe the project, ask anything (the work, starting prices, the studio for rent and its kit, the team), and name a call time in words, with the client's email, to book it (a calendar invite with a video link goes to that email"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
